viewing_check: Check crowns on each badge (King's = Tudor crown with rounded top, pre-1953; Queen's = St Edward's crown with dipped arches), maker marks on the backs (Stokes, Gaunt, Luke, Swann & Hudson, Angus & Coote = original), lugs/slider intact. Read the Casio model number on the watch back and whether the display works. Check the cameo for a 9ct mark and shell vs plastic.
